question_cn: 引入（Attraction）和引离（Deflection）的核心区别是什么？
question_en: What is the key difference between attraction and deflection?

options.text_cn: 引入只用于将杀，引离只用于赢子，两者目的不同
options.text_en: Attraction is used only for checkmate, while deflection is used only to win material

options.text_cn: 引入是把对方棋子诱到对我有利的格子（通常是危险格），引离是把对方棋子赶离它正在守护的位置（脱离职责）
options.text_en: Attraction lures an opposing piece onto a favorable, often dangerous square; deflection drives it away from a square or duty it is defending

options.text_cn: 引入需要牺牲子力，引离不需要牺牲
options.text_en: Attraction requires a sacrifice, while deflection does not

options.text_cn: 引入针对王，引离针对后——两者目标不同
options.text_en: Attraction targets the king, while deflection targets the queen

explanation_cn: 引入（Attraction）：主动方用牺牲把对方棋子「吸引到」某个对自己有利的格子——那个格子就是致命点，王去了被叉将，车去了被叉吃。引离（Deflection）：主动方迫使对方棋子「离开」它的守护职位，目标是让某个防守关键点失去保护。两者都可能需要牺牲，都可能针对各种子，区别在于：引入关注的是目标落点（落哪里），引离关注的是目标的原职（守着什么）。
explanation_en: Attraction uses a sacrifice to draw an opposing piece onto a square favorable to the attacker, often a dangerous one where a fork or mate follows. Deflection forces a piece away from its defensive post so a key point is left unprotected. Either tactic may involve a sacrifice and can target different pieces; the distinction is whether the piece is lured to a new square or driven away from a duty.
